mentions.description: A fun t-shirt brand called devopsicorn created as a print-on-demand project sold through Etsy, with designs made in collaboration with a graphic designer from Spain.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built my own fun t-shirt brand called devopsicorn, no AI used here, I worked with a graphics designer from Spain: https://devopsicorn.com

Fun project playing around with print in demand and Etsy.
